paper_title: New Limit on Axion-Like Dark Matter using Cold Neutrons
notes: Cold-neutron Ramsey (Beam EDM) search for ALP-gluon coupling via an oscillating nucleon EDM. Headline curve is the 'Beam EDM' exclusion in Fig. 4 (axionFinalAnalysis_exclusionPlot_final.png), y-axis C_G/f_a [GeV^-1] vs mass [eV]. I report the DETERMINISTIC (solid line) limit, the paper's main result (stochastic dotted line is 3.2x weaker). Values are the paper's plotted C_G/f_a; C_G is an O(1) model-dependent factor so C_G/f_a is reported directly in the canonical 1/f_a [GeV^-1] (AxionMass, EDM-type) plane. Extracted by color-detecting the lower boundary of the pink/purple exclusion fill; axes calibrated on the log-log frame (x:1e-24..1e-3 eV, y:1e-24..1e-3 GeV^-1). Cross-check: product C_G/(f_a m_a) is ~2.1-3.8e13 GeV^-2 in the central region, consistent with the paper's stated best limit 2.7e13 GeV^-2 (95% C.L.) over 5 mHz-5 Hz (m_a=2e-17..2e-14 eV); footnote example (m_a=1e-15 eV, C_G/f_a=1.4e-11) also matches. Mass range 1e-19..4e-12 eV (freq 23 uHz..1 kHz); limit worsens below ~2e-17 eV (gradient drifts) and above ~2e-14 eV (sensitivity loss). Deterministic density rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3 (not rescaled per convention). No ancillary curve data; figure is raster PNG.
